summary: Maine household of 3 (married couple, one child 6+, wife disabled and can't work), uninsured. Income answers conflict ($20-35k vs $91,100) and weren't resolved. Refundable CTC fits either way. At the lower income they would likely also qualify for SNAP, Medicaid/CHIP, EITC, school meals and possibly SSI. At about $91k, ACA premium tax credit is the likely fit. A caseworker should confirm the actual income and assets.
